caption: With s = 101 the oracle gives plus signs on 000, 010, 101, 111 and minus signs on the other four inputs. The final H^⊗3 cancels all outputs except |101⟩, which is measured with probability 1 in one oracle query.

spec.title: BV with s = 101
spec.aria: An array lists the eight 3-bit inputs, their equal superposition amplitudes, the oracle sign for s = 101, and the final amplitude concentrated on |101⟩.
